summary.intent: Unlock TurboQuant KV cache compression on a Framework Desktop with Strix Halo iGPU (gfx1151), picking up from BIOS VRAM configuration and proceeding through kernel/firmware/ROCm upgrades to enable the TurboQuant dispatch path.
summary.outcome: VRAM increased from 0.5 GB to 64 GB via BIOS UMA change. Discovered that a complete TurboQuant implementation (0xSero/turboquant v0.2.0) is already installed and importable, with Triton kernels and vLLM backend integration present. No TurboQuant dispatch was actually tested; session ended with a proposed smoke test to determine if Triton JIT-compiles for gfx1151.

repo: 0xSero/turboquant v0.2.0 is installed as an egg in cohezion/.venv and lives at research/turboquant/ in the main worktree — includes Triton kernels, vLLM attention backend plugin, benchmarks, and proof tests.
The TurboQuant integration uses VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND registration, not a --kv-cache-dtype CLI flag as the plan assumed.
Cache-gateway unlock requires TRITON_AMD_WMMA=1 + HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.5.1 (not 11.5.0 as in older Gemini PDFs).

session 94 (2026-04-16) established that PyTorch ROCm wheels lack valid ISA for gfx1151 — HSA_OVERRIDE does not fix this, it is an upstream wheel issue causing 'Invalid Device Function' / 'Memory access fault' on first Triton dispatch.
turboquant_axis dict is injected into every inference payload; Lemonade lane bindings map NPU:13306, iGPU:13307/:13308, CPU:13309.
src/cohezion/inference/turboquant_reference.py is the PyTorch correctness oracle (178 lines) for gating dispatch output against paper tolerances.
EmailNotifier class is imported by 5+ scripts but has no class definition in tracked code — orphaned import pattern.
vLLM 0.19.0 in cohezion/.venv is broken: torch 2.5.1+rocm6.2 lacks torch._inductor.custom_graph_pass that vLLM 0.19.0 requires.
llama.cpp auto-fit (-fit on, the default) hangs at 99% CPU for 2+ minutes on Gemma-4-31B Q4_K_M; -fit off resolves it.
On Strix Halo UMA, model buffers land in GTT (shared system memory), not VRAM — rocm-smi VRAM Used stays flat while GTT Used grows; this is normal for UMA APUs.
ROCm HSA exposes ~31 GB as per-process allocation ceiling while rocm-smi shows full 64 GB; the discrepancy is HSA queue reservation, not a VRAM bug.
llama.cpp PR #20969 cited in the plan is a discussion thread, not a PR. The real TurboQuant HIP/ROCm fork is TheTom/llama-cpp-turboquant; paudley's fork targets Vulkan RDNA 3.5.
Fleet is degraded: only :13306 (DeepSeek-R1-Qwen3-8B via Lemonade/FLM NPU) has a loaded model; other ports are placeholder daemons with 453 MB total VRAM used.
scripts/send_*.py has 11 near-identical email send scripts — proliferation from successive sprints rather than a consolidated utility.
amdgpu-install 30.30 and ROCm 7.2.1 apt source (repo.radeon.com/rocm/apt/7.2.1) are already configured; to upgrade to 7.2.2 use amdgpu-install --rocmrelease=7.2.2.
Kernel 6.18.4 does not exist on kernel.ubuntu.com (build failed); latest 6.18 longterm is 6.18.23, built 2026-04-18.

code.finding: Returns silently (return) when GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD is missing — silent-failure anti-pattern. The new send_handoff.py raises SystemExit(2) instead.

Newly created consolidated email utility (~90 lines): reads --subject and --body-file, markdown->HTML via optional markdown2, raises EmailNotConfigured on missing credential, uses smtplib.SMTP_SSL smtp.gmail.com:465.
Known-good llama.cpp launcher using Lemonade orchestrator with tested flags: -fa 1 -ngl 99, HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.5.1. The authoritative reference for iGPU launch parameters.
Contains distilled findings from session 94 TURBOQUANT_UNLOCK_REPORT including the PyTorch ROCm wheel ISA gap for gfx1151 and the recommended NPU/FLM workaround path.

workflow: Gmail MCP create_draft is a safe email handoff path requiring no credential management — security design intentionally allows draft creation but not autonomous send.

BIOS 'UMA Frame Buffer = Auto' on Framework Desktop with older BIOS (pre-v3.05) may only expose fixed presets (e.g., 64 GB), not a true Auto option; 'AI Max Performance' and 'PCIe Gen5' toggles require BIOS firmware update.

Always audit what is already on disk before cloning external forks — multiple sessions of prior work can leave significant artifacts (full package installs, pre-built binaries, stashed research) that are not visible in the current worktree.

Bitwarden CLI self-hosted vault (mike-poweredge-t30.tail54eb71.ts.net:8222) is the credential store; vault was locked and host unreachable during this session — have a fallback path (MCP or !export) when Bitwarden is unavailable.

The kernel/ROCm upgrade path is orthogonal to TurboQuant — it improves driver stability and may unlock VRAM beyond 64 GB, but adds zero TurboQuant code. Verify a specific regression the upgrade would fix before spending 90 min + reboots on it.

Use a targeted smoke test (single kernel dispatch with correctness check) before architectural decisions — a 15-minute test answers which of four failure modes applies and determines the actual unblock path.

Session handoff markdown files (SESSION_HANDOFF_*.md, HANDOFF_*.md, CONTINUE.md, GEMINI.md) are critical context that must be read before any planning — skipping them caused significant replanning overhead in this session.
